description: The image depicts a vast expanse of open water, likely a sea or ocean, under a transitional sky at either sunset or sunrise. Scattered, horizontally elongated clouds are present along the horizon, catching the warm light, and some fainter, smaller clouds are visible higher in the sky. This image contextually relates to the definition of "Open sea" in the document as "Open water of seas and oceans outside coastal waters."
